title: Echoes of our
subtitle: What Ingeri families say about their experience.

items.quote: Thank you very much for your thoughtful message and for the wonderful year you have shared with Ikamba. We sincerely appreciate your dedication, care, and support throughout her learning journey. We are pleased to remain part of the Ingeri community and look forward to another successful year together.❤️
items.name: Ikamba's Mother

items.quote:
As we come to the end of our child’s time with you, we just wanted to take a moment to say a very heartfelt thank you to each and every one of you. ❤️

It is honestly difficult to put into words how grateful we are for everything you have done for our little one. Thank you for the love, care, patience, kindness and attention you have given him throughout his time with you. You were not just a daycare to us you became a very important part of his little world and of our journey as parents.

Leaving is definitely bittersweet because we know he is moving on to a new chapter at nursery school, but we leave with so much gratitude in our hearts. We have watched him grow, learn, become more confident and develop so many beautiful little skills, and we truly appreciate the part you have played in that journey.

Thank you for every smile, every lesson, every comforting hug, every little achievement you celebrated with him, and for giving us the reassurance of knowing that he was in caring hands when we were away. These are memories we will always treasure. 🥹❤️

Please know that we will always look back on his time with you with so much warmth and appreciation. You have helped lay a beautiful foundation for the next chapter of his life, and for that, we will always be grateful.

As we say goodbye, we wish the entire team nothing but the very best. May you continue touching little lives and making such a beautiful difference in the lives of children and their families. ❤️

One small request before we completely leave the group 🙈❤️ could you please allow us to remain in the group for a little while longer? There are some lovely pictures that were shared with us through links, and we would really love to have some time to download and keep those memories before leaving.

Thank you once again, from the bottom of our hearts, for everything. We will truly miss you all. ❤️🥹

With so much love and appreciation, papa and mama Elijah.
items.name: Elijah's Parents

items.quote:
Hello Madam and the whole team at La P'tite Crèche Ingeri,

Allow me to thank you from the bottom of my heart for all your love, patience, and gentleness that marked Igabe's first steps. He has really learned so much, and you have always been like his second little home.

Thank you for every act of tenderness and every lesson learned. Thank you especially to Miss Deborah for her patience with him, particularly in those first weeks at the daycare, and to Miss Assoumpta and the "big mamans" as well. We love you and pray that God blesses you always.

"For God is not unjust so as to forget your work and the love you have shown…" — Hebrews 6:10
